profileDescription: Your account details and security settings.
changePasswordHint: After the change, other devices have to sign in again.
phoneInvalid: A phone number may contain digits and + ( ) - . only.

avatarTooLarge: The avatar must be smaller than 15MB.
usernameInvalid: A username needs at least 3 characters, using letters, digits and . _ - only.
emailInvalid: The email address is not valid.
usernameTaken: That username is already in use.
emailTaken: That email address is already in use.
identityAdminHint: A full-access account may change its own username and email. The next sign-in uses the new ones.

signature.title: Electronic signature
signature.hint: The signature is printed on the quotations, slips and PDF documents you issue.
signature.uploadHint: Sign on white paper with a dark pen, then take a photo. After uploading you can rotate it, frame the signature and tune the background removal.

signature.photoTooLarge: The signature photo must be smaller than 15MB.
signature.noInkFound: No signature strokes were found in the photo. Take a clearer photo on white paper.
signature.drawHint: Sign with a mouse, a stylus or your finger in the box below.
signature.sensitivityHint: Lower it to drop ruled lines and smudges; raise it to keep thin pen strokes.
signature.removeLines: Remove ruled lines and paper edges
signature.reviewNotice: A new signature needs an administrator’s approval. Until then, documents keep printing the current one.
signature.submitted: New signature sent to an administrator for approval.
signature.pendingHint: This signature applies only once an administrator approves it.
